messages.subject: For Reina | Global Natural Resources Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Reina,

Your work as Senior Recruitment Consultant across APAC natural resources makes this a focused introduction rather than a general CV submission. I am pursuing senior expatriate and cross-border mandates where operating discipline, government relations, sustainability and stakeholder strategy sit close to business delivery.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at Aurora Gold Mines Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, in Guyana. My remit spans ESG and sustainability, government and regulatory relations, social performance, corporate and external affairs, compliance, aviation interfaces, stakeholder strategy and executive communications in a large-scale gold-mining environment.

Across 12+ years in mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, I have worked at the intersection of international investment, government, communities and complex operating requirements. My current portfolio includes renewable-energy transition, carbon-accounting initiatives and major-project stakeholder coordination. I hold an MBA and have completed executive development in China and the UAE.

I am open to Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Leadership and VP-track roles across mining, energy transition, infrastructure and regulated industrial businesses. Residential, expatriate and rotational assignments are all within scope. I would value consideration for current or upcoming mandates where a globally mobile leader with strong ESG, government affairs and country-facing depth fits the brief.

My executive CV is attached. Current online CV: https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/resume.html

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
https://www.linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop/
